entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: A region near Ronom Lake on Dominaria with oil and forests, devastated in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Whose arrival ended the rebels' hold-out.

entities.name: Isak Glen'Dard
entities.description: Shapeshifter who was a client of the new Sarinth's brothels.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War that threatened and destroyed Sarinth.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Glacier that later overran the second Sarinth.

events.summary: Mishra's forces conquer Sarinth around 44 AR; rebels hold out until Ashnod arrives.
events.quote: Sarinth was conquered by Mishra 's forces around 44 AR

events.summary: Around 55 AR the Sarinthian people rebel against their Fallaji captors.
events.quote: the Sarinthian people began to rebel against their Fallaji captors

events.summary: By war's end Sarinth is a wreckage and its great city destroyed.
events.quote: The great city that had resisted Mishra had been destroyed for its sin.

events.summary: Centuries later a new Sarinth is built over the ruins, known for brothels.
events.quote: a new Sarinth had been built over the ruins of the old one

events.summary: The second Sarinth falls to the wandering Ronom Glacier in the Ice Age.
events.quote: this second Sarinth later fell to the wandering of Ronom Glacier

relations.note: Conquered by and rebelled against him.
relations.quote: starting a revolution to overthrow Mishra's tyranny
